items.docs: This API operation revokes a pending organization invitation in Grafana by deleting it using the specified invitation code. When executed via a DELETE request to the endpoint /org/invites/{invitation_code}/revoke, it cancels an outstanding invitation that was previously sent to a user, preventing them from accepting it and joining the organization. items.docs: This API operation allows a Grafana administrator to forcibly revoke a specific authentication token for a given user by making a POST request to the endpoint with the target user's ID. This API operation allows for the revocation of a specific authentication token associated with a user in Grafana. When invoked via a POST request to the /user/revoke-auth-token endpoint, it invalidates the specified auth token, effectively logging out the user from any session using that particular token.
